# Inspection Checklist Template

**Document ID:** TMP-INSP-001
**Version:** 1.0
**Status:** Template
**Published:** 2026-08-03

---

# Purpose

This template provides a standardized checklist for conducting property inspections under the Property Operations Guide (POG).

The goal is to ensure inspections are consistent, comprehensive, and produce actionable maintenance items.

Completed inspection reports belong in the future Private Operations Repository.

# Usage Notes

This checklist is intended to be completed during every formal property inspection.

Inspection findings should generate maintenance records, project records, or vendor work orders as appropriate.

---

# Guiding Principle

An inspection is valuable only if it results in informed action.

Every significant finding should either be accepted, monitored, or resolved.
